tagline: A collective of dynamic design brands shaping workplaces, homes, and communities through over 100 years of design leadership and innovation.
hero_kpi_rationale: MillerKnoll's strength lies in its diversified portfolio of globally recognized design brands, collectively representing more than 100 years of design research and exploration. This enables the company to connect with new audiences and markets.

kpis.name: Product Portfolio and Brand Collective
kpis.explanation: MillerKnoll's strength lies in its diversified portfolio of globally recognized design brands, including Herman Miller, Knoll, Muuto, HAY, Design Within Reach, and ten other prestigious brands.
kpis.description: MillerKnoll is a collective of 13 dynamic design brands including Herman Miller, Knoll, Colebrook Bosson Saunders, DatesWeiser, Design Within Reach, Edelman, Geiger, HAY, Holly Hunt, KnollTextiles, Maharam, Muuto, NaughtOne, and Spinneybeck|FilzFelt, which collectively shape living and working spaces.
kpis.signal: Growth driver through brand diversification and synergies.

kpis.name: Design Leadership
kpis.explanation: The company's commitment to developing innovative, research-driven design products with a history of collaboration with renowned designers.
kpis.description: The company is recognized for its more than 100-year history of developing research-based products and aesthetic innovation, in collaboration with a global network of renowned independent designers.
kpis.signal: Sustains competitive advantage through innovation and design heritage.

kpis.name: Unique Business Model
kpis.explanation: Unique multi-channel distribution capacity in the furniture industry, covering dealers, direct sales, retail, e-commerce, and catalogs.
kpis.description: MillerKnoll has developed a multi-channel distribution capability, including independent contract furniture dealers, direct sales to customers, company-owned and franchised retail stores, mail-order catalogs, and localized e-commerce platforms.
kpis.signal: Flexibility and extended reach to serve diverse customers across multiple channels.

kpis.name: Global Scale and Reach
kpis.explanation: Global network of designers, suppliers, manufacturing operations, and R&D centers enabling service to over 100 countries.
kpis.description: The company operates a global network of designers, suppliers, manufacturing operations in 8 countries (United States, Canada, Mexico, United Kingdom, Italy, Brazil, China, India) and R&D centers, enabling it to efficiently serve its contract and residential customers in over 100 countries.
kpis.signal: Ability to serve customers at global scale with integrated operations and strategy execution.

kpis.name: Retail Studios
kpis.explanation: Number of retail studios operated directly by MillerKnoll, including brands DWR, HAY, Herman Miller, Muuto, and Knoll.
kpis.description: As of May 31, 2025, MillerKnoll operated 78 retail studios (38 under the Design Within Reach brand, 30 Herman Miller stores, 3 Muuto stores, 2 Knoll stores, 1 HAY store, and 1 multi-brand store in Chicago) plus 3 outlet studios.
kpis.signal: Expansion of retail presence for direct consumer engagement and Global Retail segment growth.

kpis.name: Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Total revenue for MillerKnoll for the fiscal year ended May 31, 2025.
kpis.description: Net sales for fiscal year 2025 reached $3.67 billion, up 1.1% from $3.63 billion in fiscal 2024, down from $4.09 billion in 2023.
kpis.signal: Moderate revenue growth despite challenging competitive environment and macroeconomic headwinds.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Gross margin expressed in billions of dollars, reflecting profitability after deducting cost of sales.
kpis.description: Gross margin reached $1.42 billion in 2025, flat versus $1.42 billion in 2024 and comparable to $1.43 billion in 2023, representing a gross margin percentage of approximately 38.7%.
kpis.signal: Gross margin stability despite modest sales growth, suggesting cost pressures.

kpis.name: Operating Earnings
kpis.explanation: Operating earnings in millions of dollars, after deducting all operating expenses including SG&A, depreciation charges, and restructuring charges.
kpis.description: Operating earnings declined to $51 million in 2025, down 69.8% versus $167 million in 2024, primarily due to a $130 million impairment charge compared to $17 million in 2024.
kpis.signal: Significant operating profitability decline driven principally by $130 million impairment charges and increased SG&A expenses.

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.explanation: Total debt amount following the Knoll acquisition, constraining financial flexibility.
kpis.description: Total debt stands at approximately $1.31 billion as of May 31, 2025, reflecting Knoll acquisition financing and limiting financial flexibility with restrictive covenants.
kpis.signal: High post-acquisition leverage constitutes a material risk to capital structure and financial flexibility.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

risks.title: High leverage post-Knoll acquisition
risks.score_rationale: Risk is central to the 10-K, with $1.31 billion debt as of May 2025. Language emphasizes reduced financial flexibility, restrictive covenants, and acceleration risk in default scenarios. Capital category heavily weighted. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Risk of execution failure on growth strategy
risks.score_rationale: Positioned as top risk, mentions uncertain projections, execution failures, and risky investments. Cautious but repeated language. Less existential than leverage risk. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Increased competition in furniture industry
risks.score_rationale: Multiple paragraphs detail competitive pressures, particularly in retail. Language underscores risks to margins and market share loss. Less critical than leverage. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Exposure to geopolitical and trade tensions
risks.score_rationale: Repeated references to Ukraine-Russia conflict, Middle East tensions, and China-US trade war. Supply chain and cost impacts cited. Language concerned but not alarmist. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Foreign exchange volatility and international risks
risks.score_rationale: Risk cited for multiple currencies (pound, krone, euro). Impacts customer purchasing power and profitability. Position material but secondary in text. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Supply chain material disruptions
risks.score_rationale: Key supply chain risk, with dependence on external suppliers. Language underscores production and customer demand impacts. Less global than macro risks. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Demand pressures from economic slowdown
risks.score_rationale: Material macroeconomic factor cited linked to corporate profitability and employment. Language repetitive and concerned, but less directly tied to balance sheet structure. (default score, to be refined)

ai_positioning.summary: The 10-K text provided contains no information on MillerKnoll's positioning regarding artificial intelligence or its impact on corporate strategy.
